system.description: Slot 3 on an Ebon Staff (requires Embarkation & Destination Rings). Bears the Fire rune. Elevates the Ebon Staff to a +4 magic weapon, adds Burning Hands, Fireball, and Flame Arrow (1/day each at 6th caster level, if the wielder can cast spells of that level), and allows the staff to act as a Wand of Fiery Burning once per day.
